events.pleaseNote: The Price is Right LIVE contestant registration is now handled in advance, with online links that are unique to each performance and were advanced with the venue presenter and/or marketing team. Please read through this section carefully. Advanced materials include a link to the registration survey as well as materials including a QR code directing patrons to the link if they have not registered prior to attending the performance. Name Tag Check-in begins at the venue two (2) hours prior to show time. All arriving guests will need to receive a Name Tag, which will be handwritten and distributed by local FOH staff. Training for this process will occur in the half hour prior to Name Tag Check-in.

events.info: ONE NIGHT, TWO OLD RIVALS. Don't miss the Battle at the BIGIRON as Nebraska and Kansas State collide in a high-intensity men's basketball exhibition at the BIGIRON Events Center. This is your chance to see elite Division 1 talent up close as these programs gear up for the season. Expect a fast pace, big plays, and a game day atmosphere you won't want to miss. Limited seats available - get yours now.

events.name: Ink The Island Tattoo Convention: Friday Single Day Pass
events.info: This will be the first annual Ink The Island Tattoo Convention in Grand Island, Nebraska. Ink The Island Tattoo Convention was founded with a shared vision: to bring a premier tattoo event to the heart of Nebraska, showcasing the talent, artistry, and culture that define the tattoo industry. Rooted in Grand Island, we are a team whose combined experience, dedication, and passion have laid the foundation for a convention created by the community, for the community. Together, we are committed to creating a high-quality, inclusive, and artist-centered convention that elevates tattoo culture in Grand Island and beyond. We look forward to building an annual event that celebrates artistry, inspires connection, and leaves a lasting impact on our community. We will continue to update this site as we receive applications for artists & vendors, and as we secure entertainment, as well as speakers for the Tattoo Seminar!
